subject: PEER CHECK: Alpha3 diagnostic export completeness after flush failure
claim_to_check: DuoApp can continue export/upload after flushDebugLogs() returns false, and the resulting bundle lacks a machine-decidable flush/drop completeness marker; ZIP SHA-256 therefore proves transport integrity but not telemetry completeness.
requested_distinct_method: Independently inspect current-main call flow or construct a synthetic queue-full/flush-timeout reproduction. Do not treat the originating 7-test harness as the sole corroboration.
english_summary: Manager source review corroborated the finding, but promotion is intentionally held until a distinct peer independently checks the export-boundary claim.
